0.0: Hmmm... You look like someone that likes adventure. Can I ask you for a few favors? It's not going to be easy, but if you get the job done, I'll reward you well for it!

yes.0: Cool! What I am going to ask from you is simple. Ludibrium is a floating castle supported by two huge towers, so to get down to the ground level, you'll need to go through Eos Tower, a tower of mind-numbing heights.
yes.1: It's a very important tower, but the cleaning hasn't been done lately, and the tower is now infiltrated with filthy monsters. I can't move from my duties here as a guard, so I was hoping if you can go in the tower and take care of some monsters.
yes.2: A #r#o3110102##k is a large mouse-like creature with a wind-up key on its back. They've been taking over Eos Tower. Thin them out by taking care of #r50#k of them. You can find them between #b#m221022900##k and #b#m221023200##k.

no.0: Really. This task isn't that difficult, and I think you can do it. If you have any free time, then come talk to me.

1.0: Awesome! You took out all of them! There must have been quite a few #b#o3110102#s#k roaming around Eos Tower. Anyway, thank you for helping me out. I'll give you an item only available in Ludibrium that you'll need to use for hunting. Please take it!

yes.0: Thank you so much for your help, but it seems like Eos Tower is still full of nasty monsters. I have a lot to ask of you, so if you have any free time, please come talk to me.

mob.0: I don't think you did what I asked of you. Please head to Eos Tower and take out #b50 #o3110102#s#k.
